text:
sam: Heads up — cut for v1.12 is blocked, CI matrix 'integration-e2e/node-matrix' timed out on parallel shards after ~35m.
ci-bot: [build #4821] job integration-e2e/node-matrix failed: timeout (exit code 124). Logs: `worker startup exceeded 30s, requeued` x12.
jen: Ugh we saw flakiness on that suite yesterday but it only affected one shard then. Any recent infra or baseimage bumps?
kevin: There was a base image bump in the last PR (python:3.11-slim -> custom:py311-ridx) that changed container startup; I pinned it in a local branch but didn't push.
maria: Also noticing a higher cache miss rate on the remote cache cluster — eviction TTL bumped last week for cleanup. That might explain slower container pulls and startup.
sam: So two factors: slower pulls from cache + base image change. Options: 1) increase job timeout (temporary), 2) disable matrix parallelism and run sequentially (slower but deterministic), 3) pin older base image and re-run, 4) rollback the commit. Thoughts?
jen: For a release cut I'd prefer pinning the base image and re-running CI — smallest blast radius. If that passes we can ship and then follow up with infra fix.
kevin: I can open a quick PR to pin to `python:3.11-slim@sha256:abcd1234` and bump the timeout to 60m in the workflow as a fallback.
release-oncall: We need to decide within the change window. If we hold past the 2pm window, release slips to next day. Can we get a canary pin + smoke deploy to staging quickly?
ci-bot: deploy-bot triggered: canary-deploy/staging v1.12-candidate -> queued.
maria: If we pin and it passes, we should add a note to release notes about deferring the baseimage upgrade and link the follow-up issue to track cache TTL tuning.
sam: Agreed. Action items: kevin to PR pin + timeout (now), jen to run the matrix sequentially if pin doesn't land fast, maria to open infra ticket for cache TTL and region pull health, release-oncall to hold cut until green.
kevin: PR opened: #6578 pin baseimage + CI timeout. Kicking off pipeline.
ci-bot: [build #4822] triggered by kevin in branch pin/baseimage-6578.
jen: If that fails, we'll fall back to disabling parallelism and run a single shard to at least validate core flows before deciding rollback.
sam: OK hold for results. If green, push release cut and update release notes with the deferral/issue. If still failing after the sequential run, rollback the last dependency bump (PR 6561) and re-run.
deploy-bot: Reminder: change window ends at 14:00 UTC.
ci-bot: [build #4822] success — all matrix shards passed after pin.
kevin: Nice. I'll merge #6578 and trigger the release cut.
release-oncall: Proceeding with cut. I'll post to #announcements with the release note addendum: baseimage upgrade deferred, infra ticket #324 opened for cache TTL tuning.
sam: Thanks everyone. Follow-up: we should add a CI health check that alerts when cache miss rate > 10% to avoid surprises during cut windows.
maria: Filed infra ticket #324 with details and logs.
jen: Great teamwork :thumbsup:
ci-bot: deploy-bot: release v1.12 created and scheduled to rollout canary -> prod per policy.
